chunks: Remember, when you said to Moses: "We shall not believe in you until we see God face to face," lightning struck you as you looked.
ai.seo_question: What happened to the Children of Israel when they demanded to see God face to face?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the Israelites' literalist demand for a visible manifestation of the Divine, which led to their temporary death by lightning (al-Sa'iqah) as a consequence of their superficial faith. This event serves as a cautionary tale against equating physical sight with spiritual conviction, emphasizing that true belief requires inner certainty rather than mere sensory proof.
